sentences.text:
For the Informant : Mr. G.M.Singh, Adv.
--
06/19.05.2023

The applicant-husband who is in custody since 01.11.2022 has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Narkopi P.S. Case No. 26 of 2022, registered for the offence under Sections 323/324/498A/506/511/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
Earlier, the applicant has been granted provisional bail vide order dated 03.02.2023.
Learned counsel for the informant has opposed the prayer for bail.
Considering the period of custody, provisional bail granted vide order dated 03.02.2023 is hereby confirmed.
The applicant is directed to produce fresh bail bond within four weeks.
